CBA.definition: Three or more months overdue; account count, reporting CBA member banks.

TransUnion.access: Verified through web PDF reader. Direct download returned HTTP 403; hash below covers this cached factual extract, not the inaccessible PDF bytes.

table.wholesale_net_writeoffs: Allowance for credit losses, printed/PDF page 178

RBC.scope: RBC consolidated except specifically Canada-labeled PCL. One banking group, not Canada totals; net write-offs, provisions and fiscal recapitalisations are different measures. No model parameter fitted.

scope_correction: RBC .10% (2022) and .14% (2023) are consolidated ALL-loan net write-off ratios, not household-only ratios. Retain the requested range as an explicitly imperfect order-of-magnitude gate, not a validated household calibration target.

N.source: labelled assumption retained from accepted F; no Canada-wide legal foreclosure time is asserted
N.uncertainty: roughly 7-9 months from first missed instalment under quarterly buckets; provincial procedures vary

haircut.source: labelled stress-sale discount assumption, not a measured transaction-cost rate

unsecured_recovery.rule: Existing non-pension financial assets are included in servicing resources first; residual formal unsecured principal written off after N quarters
unsecured_recovery.source: model accounting choice; no fitted recovery fraction

no_buyer.rule: Mortgage stays as encumbering bank claim in foreclosure queue, collateral legally retained pending sale; no cash recovery or mortgage write-off before executed sale
no_buyer.source: explicit holding treatment; not bank REO ownership

arrears.rule: Interest first then principal, pro rata by lender/type. Non-accrual unpaid-interest memo; principal arrears remain in loan book. Monthly buckets inferred from equal monthly due dates and cash available first.
arrears.source: quarterly timing assumption, not observed monthly income or loan-level data
